DLG-SC-LOC-002-21-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-21-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。口座の画面で何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-21-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. How can I help you with the account screen?

DLG-SC-LOC-002-21-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-21-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 残高のところが丸い印だけになっています。残高がゼロなのか、表示が隠れているのか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-21-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 残高の丸印がゼロか伏字か確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-21-001-SHARED-02.translation: The balance section only shows round dots. I'd like to check whether the balance is zero or the display is hidden.
DLG-SC-LOC-002-21-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want to know whether the balance dots mean zero or hidden numbers.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-21-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-21-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この画面は金額を伏せた表示です。丸い印がゼロ円を表しているわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-21-001-SHARED-03.translation: This screen is hiding the amount. The dots do not mean the balance is zero yen.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-21-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-21-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 金額がなくなったと思っていました。表示を戻す操作だけ教えてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-21-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 金額消失と誤解したと認め、表示の切替操作だけ説明を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-21-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought the money had disappeared. Could you just show me how to restore the display?
DLG-SC-LOC-002-21-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Admit the misunderstanding in Japanese that the money had disappeared, and ask only for instructions to switch the display.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-21-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-21-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 右の表示切替を、ご自身で押せます。押した後の金額は私に読み上げなくて結構です。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-21-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can press the display toggle on the right yourself. You don't need to read the amount aloud to me afterwards.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-21-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-21-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 自分で押します。同行者にも画面を見せず、金額を声に出さないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-21-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分で操作し、同行者に見せず金額を読み上げないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-21-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll press it myself. I won't show the screen to the person with me or say the amount aloud.
DLG-SC-LOC-002-21-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will operate it yourself, without showing your companion or reading the amount aloud.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-21-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-21-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認が済んだら、同じボタンでまた伏せられます。別の取引をしたいご希望はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-21-001-SHARED-07.translation: After checking, you can hide it again with the same button. Is there another transaction you'd like to make?

DLG-SC-LOC-002-21-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-21-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日は残高の確認だけです。表示を見たことと、引き出しをしたことを混同しないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-21-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 今日は確認だけで、表示確認を引出しと混同しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-21-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'm only checking the balance today. I'll be careful not to confuse viewing the balance with making a withdrawal.
DLG-SC-LOC-002-21-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that today is only a balance check, and you will not confuse checking the display with withdrawing money.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-21-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-21-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 残高確認だけなら、ここで引出操作を始める必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-21-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you're only checking your balance, you don't need to start a withdrawal here.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-21-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-002-21-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 金額を確認できました。表示を伏せ直し、今日は取引せず画面を閉じます。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-21-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自分で金額確認でき、伏字へ戻して取引せず画面を閉じると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-21-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've checked the amount. I'll hide the display again and close the screen without making a transaction today.
DLG-SC-LOC-002-21-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you checked the amount yourself, will hide it again, and close the screen without making a transaction.

DLG-SC-LOC-002-21-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-002-21-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。ご自身で確認できましたね。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-002-21-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. You've been able to check it yourself. Thank you for your inquiry.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-003-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いできますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-003-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-003-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 一つ前の駅で降りる予定でしたが、気づかずここまで来てしまいました。引き返したいので、どうすればよいか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 降りる駅を一つ乗り過ごしたため引き返す方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I meant to get off one station earlier, but didn't notice and came all the way here. I'd like to go back, so please tell me what to do.
DLG-SC-LOC-003-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese how to go back after missing your station by one stop.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-003-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 承知しました。お持ちの切符を確認します。まだ改札の外へは出ていませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Understood. I'll check your ticket. You haven't gone outside the ticket gates yet, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-003-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-003-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、ホームからこの窓口へ来ただけです。この切符の到着駅で降りるはずでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 改札を出ていないと答え目的駅が書かれた切符を見せる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: That's right. I only came from the platform to this counter. I was supposed to get off at the destination printed on this ticket.
DLG-SC-LOC-003-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Answer in Japanese that you have not exited the gates, and show the ticket with your intended station.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-003-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 切符の扱いを担当に確認します。その間、先ほどの列車へ戻ろうとせず、こちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll ask the person responsible how your ticket should be handled. Meanwhile, please wait here rather than trying to return to the train you were on.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-003-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: わかりました。反対側に停まっている列車へ自分で乗るのも、確認が済むまでは待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 切符確認が終わるまで反対方向の列車にも勝手に乗らないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I'll also wait for the check to finish before boarding the train stopped on the opposite side on my own.
DLG-SC-LOC-003-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not board the train in the opposite direction on your own until the ticket check is complete.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-003-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。戻る方向の案内も確認してお伝えします。目的の駅で待っている方はいらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. We'll also confirm and explain the direction for going back. Is anyone waiting at your destination station?

DLG-SC-LOC-003-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-003-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 友人が改札の外で待っています。乗り過ごしたので遅れると連絡し、到着時刻はまだ伝えないでおきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 待つ友人へ遅れると連絡し到着時刻は未確認と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: A friend is waiting outside the ticket gates. I'll tell them I'll be late because I missed my stop, but won't give an arrival time yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-003-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will tell your waiting friend you are delayed and that the arrival time is not yet confirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-003-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 現在の手続きと戻る列車が決まってから、到着の見込みをご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check your estimated arrival once the current procedure and return train are decided.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-003-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 友人に遅れると伝えました。切符の扱いと戻る方向の案内を聞いてから移動します。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 友人への連絡後に切符取扱いと戻る方向の案内を待つと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've told my friend I'll be late. I'll wait for instructions about the ticket and the direction back before moving.
DLG-SC-LOC-003-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have contacted your friend and will wait for instructions on ticket handling and the direction back.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-003-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。担当が確認するまでこちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please wait here until the person responsible has checked.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-003-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。見学で何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you with your visit?

DLG-SC-LOC-003-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-003-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 見学を予約しました。あそこで人数を数えている列へ入ればいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 予約見学のため人数確認中の列へ参加してよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've booked a guided visit. Should I join that line where people are being counted?
DLG-SC-LOC-003-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether you may join the line where people are being counted for your booked tour.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-003-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 予約の案内名と時刻を見せてください。あちらは別団体の集合です。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please show me your tour name and time. That is a different group's meeting.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-003-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私の予約は街の歴史案内で、開始は二時です。今は一時半ですが同じ列と思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自分の案内名と二時開始を示し別団体の列と取り違えたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: My booking is for the city history tour, starting at two. It's one thirty now, but I thought it was the same line.
DLG-SC-LOC-003-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show your tour name and two o'clock start time and explain in Japanese that you confused it with another group's line.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-003-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その予約の受付は一時四十五分から、この案内板の横です。今は並ばずお待ちいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Check-in for that booking starts at one forty-five beside this information board. You can wait without lining up for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-003-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 別団体の人数に入らないようにします。同行者は売店にいるので、こちらへ来るよう連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 別団体の人数に入らず売店の同行者へ正しい集合場所を連絡すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll make sure I'm not counted as part of the other group. My companion is at the shop, so I'll tell them to come here.
DLG-SC-LOC-003-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will avoid being counted in the other group and tell your companion in the shop the correct meeting point.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-003-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 同行者の方も同じ予約ですか。一人分の予約か二人分か控えをご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Is your companion on the same booking? Please check whether your confirmation is for one person or two.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-003-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 控えは二人分です。二人そろって受付します。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 控えで二人分の予約と確認し同行者とそろって受付すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: The confirmation is for two. We'll check in together when we're both here.
DLG-SC-LOC-003-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese from the booking record that it is for two and say you will check in together.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-003-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 受付前に順路へ進まないでください。案内人が集合後に出発をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please don't start along the route before checking in. The guide will tell you when to depart after everyone has gathered.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-003-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二人分の控えを持って案内板横で待ちます。一時四十五分になったら受付して、案内人と出発します。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 受付開始まで案内板横で待ち控えを提示して案内人と出発すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll wait beside the information board with the confirmation for two. At one forty-five we'll check in and depart with the guide.
DLG-SC-LOC-003-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will wait by the information board until check-in opens, show your confirmation, and leave with the guide.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-003-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。その予約の集合場所はこちらです。どうぞ見学をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, this is the meeting point for that booking. Please enjoy your visit.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-003-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。今日は何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you today?

DLG-SC-LOC-003-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-003-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 受診の説明が聞き取れるか不安です。遠くにいる家族へ電話して、言葉を助けてもらうことはできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 遠方の家族による電話での言語支援を診療説明に利用できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm worried about understanding the explanation during my medical visit. Could I phone a family member who lives far away to help with the language?
DLG-SC-LOC-003-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether a distant family member can provide language support by phone during medical explanations.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-003-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 診療担当へ確認します。家族の方は、説明が終わるまで通話できる予定でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check with the medical staff. Will your family member be able to stay on the phone until the explanation finishes?

DLG-SC-LOC-003-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-003-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 午後二時までしか話せません。仕事中なので、それ以降は電話を切る必要があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 家族は勤務中のため午後二時までしか通話できないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: They can only talk until two in the afternoon. They are at work, so they need to end the call after that.
DLG-SC-LOC-003-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that your family member is working and can only stay on the phone until two p.m.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-003-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その時間の制限も担当へ伝えます。病院側の通訳方法が使えるかも確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll also tell the staff about that time limit. Let's check whether the hospital's interpreting options can be used too.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-003-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。家族の通話が切れたら、わかったふりをせず、別の説明方法を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 通話が切れた場合は未理解を伝え別の説明方法を相談したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. If the family call ends, I don't want to pretend I understand; I'd like to discuss another way to receive the explanation.
DLG-SC-LOC-003-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that if the call ends, you will explain that you have not understood and want to discuss another method of explanation.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-003-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。ご本人が理解できていない点をその場で職員へお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. Please tell a staff member at the time about anything you haven't understood yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-003-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家族にあとで聞かせるため説明を録音する案も考えましたが、許可なく始めず担当に聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 説明録音は許可を得るまで始めず担当へ可否を聞くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I also considered recording the explanation for my family to hear later, but I won't start without permission and will ask the person responsible.
DLG-SC-LOC-003-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not begin recording the explanation before getting permission and will ask the person responsible whether it is allowed.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-003-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 録音の可否は担当へ相談してください。電話同席の希望と時間制限は今引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please discuss permission to record with the person responsible. I'll pass on your request for family participation by phone and the time limit now.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-003-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。家族は二時までと伝え、電話か別の方法かを職員と決めてから説明を受けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 家族の時間制限を伝え職員と説明方法を決めてから説明を受ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I'll explain that my family member is available until two, decide with the staff whether to use the phone or another method, and then receive the explanation.
DLG-SC-LOC-003-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will explain your family's time limit, decide the explanation method with staff, and then receive it.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-003-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。確認できましたらご案内しますので、お待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please wait, and we'll let you know when we've confirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-003-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いできますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-003-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-003-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日、鍵をなくした件で相談しました。その時に伝えた職場の電話では連絡を受けられなくなったので、連絡先を変えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 昨日の鍵紛失相談で登録した職場電話を変更したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I spoke to you yesterday about losing my keys. I can no longer receive calls on the work number I gave then, so I'd like to change my contact details.
DLG-SC-LOC-003-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese to change the work phone number registered during yesterday's lost-key inquiry.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-003-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 昨日の相談を確認します。お名前と、お持ちなら受付の控えをお見せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check yesterday's inquiry. Please show me your name and, if you have it, the receipt for the inquiry.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-003-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 名前はこちらです。この控えも持っています。職場は今日から長期休業で、私もそこへ行きません。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 氏名と控えを示し職場の長期休業で連絡を受けられないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: My name is here. I have this receipt too. My workplace is closing for an extended holiday from today, and I won't be going there either.
DLG-SC-LOC-003-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show your name and receipt and explain in Japanese that you cannot receive calls because your workplace is closed for an extended period.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-003-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 記録を確認しました。変更したいのは、鍵の特徴ではなく連絡先のお電話ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: I've checked the record. What you want to change is your contact telephone number, not the key description, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-003-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-003-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。自分の携帯番号へお願いします。鍵二本と青いキーホルダーという特徴は同じです。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 鍵の特徴は変わらず個人携帯への変更だけ希望すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. Please change it to my own mobile number. The description of two keys and a blue key ring is unchanged.
DLG-SC-LOC-003-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Answer in Japanese that the keys' description is unchanged and you only want to switch to your personal mobile number.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-003-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では新しい番号を確認します。末尾が二四八六で間違いありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then I'll confirm the new number. Does it end in 2486?

DLG-SC-LOC-003-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-003-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 合っています。ただ、夜勤中は出られないことがあります。出られなかったら折り返してよい連絡先も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 新番号末尾を確認し夜勤で出られない場合の折返し先を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: That's correct. However, I may not be able to answer while working night shifts. Please also tell me which number I can call back if I miss a call.
DLG-SC-LOC-003-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the new number's final digits in Japanese and ask where to call back if you cannot answer during a night shift.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-003-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 折返しはこちらの窓口へお願いします。変更受付はできましたが、鍵が見つかったという連絡ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please call this counter back. We've accepted the contact change, but this is not a notification that the keys have been found.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-003-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: わかりました。携帯への連絡を待ち、出られなければこの窓口へ折り返します。鍵の発見はまだ未確認ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 携帯への連絡と折返し方法を確認し鍵はまだ発見未確認と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll wait for a call on my mobile, and if I can't answer, I'll call this counter back. The keys have not yet been confirmed found, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-003-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese the mobile contact and callback procedure, and that finding the keys is still unconfirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-003-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。必要なご連絡はこちらからいたします。ご変更をお知らせいただき、ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Correct. We will contact you when needed. Thank you for informing us of the change.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-003-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。何かお手伝いできますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-003-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-003-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: このズボンを仕事用に買いたいです。裾が長いので、直してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 購入予定の仕事用ズボンの裾直しを依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to buy these trousers for work. They're too long; could you shorten the hems?
DLG-SC-LOC-003-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for hemming on the work trousers you plan to buy.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-003-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 承れます。まず試着していただき、普段合わせる靴で長さを見ましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: We can do that. First, please try them on so we can check the length with the shoes you normally wear with them.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-003-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今日はサンダルですが、仕事では厚い底の靴を履きます。その靴は持ってきていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 普段合わせる仕事靴を持参していないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'm wearing sandals today, but at work I wear thick-soled shoes. I haven't brought those shoes.
DLG-SC-LOC-003-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you have not brought the work shoes you normally wear with the trousers.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-003-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: それでしたら今日は裾の位置を決めず、お仕事用の靴で合わせたほうがよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: In that case, rather than deciding the hem position today, it would be better to check it with your work shoes.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-003-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 夕方に靴を持って戻れます。商品を取り置きして、採寸はその時にお願いしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 夕方に靴を持参するため商品を取り置いてほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can return this evening with the shoes. I'd like you to reserve the trousers and take the measurements then.
DLG-SC-LOC-003-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese to reserve the item because you will bring your shoes this evening.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-003-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 本日中はお取り置きできます。夕方の受付ですと、仕上がりは明後日になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can hold them until the end of today. If we take your order this evening, they will be ready the day after tomorrow.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-003-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 明日から使いたかったのですが、合わない長さで急ぐより明後日でお願いします。料金はいくらですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 翌日使用を諦め明後日の仕上げを選び料金を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I wanted to use them from tomorrow, but rather than rushing to an unsuitable length, I'll take the day after tomorrow. How much will it cost?
DLG-SC-LOC-003-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will give up using them tomorrow and choose completion the day after tomorrow, and ask the price.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-003-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この仕上げ方は七百円です。夕方に長さを決め、料金と受取票をご確認いただきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: This type of hemming costs 700 yen. This evening, we'll decide the length and ask you to confirm the charge and collection ticket.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-003-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 七百円ですね。夕方、仕事靴を持って試着し、明後日の受取りで注文します。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 夕方の試着と七百円の裾直しを明後日受取りで注文すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: 700 yen, then. I'll come this evening with my work shoes, try them on, and order them for collection the day after tomorrow.
DLG-SC-LOC-003-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will try them on this evening and order 700-yen hemming with collection the day after tomorrow.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-003-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: かしこまりました。お名前を伺ってお取り置きします。夕方お待ちしております。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. I'll take your name and reserve them. We look forward to seeing you this evening.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-003-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。お買物でお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Do you need help with your shopping?

DLG-SC-LOC-003-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-003-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 同僚四人の夕食を買います。皆から集めた千五百円以内で、野菜炒めの材料をそろえたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 四人分の夕食材料を集めた千五百円以内で選びたいと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm buying dinner for four coworkers. I'd like to get ingredients for a meat-and-vegetable stir-fry within the 1,500 yen we collected from everyone.
DLG-SC-LOC-003-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for help choosing dinner ingredients for four within the 1,500 yen collected.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-003-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご飯や調味料も今回お買いになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Are you also buying rice and seasonings this time?

DLG-SC-LOC-003-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-003-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 米と油と調味料は家にあります。必要なのは肉と野菜だけです。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 米と調味料は家にあり肉と野菜だけ必要だと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: We have rice, oil and seasonings at home. We only need meat and vegetables.
DLG-SC-LOC-003-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Answer in Japanese that rice and seasonings are at home and only meat and vegetables are needed.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-003-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この野菜の組合せで六百円です。肉の大袋を加えると、合計千八百円になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: This combination of vegetables is 600 yen. Adding the large pack of meat would bring the total to 1,800 yen.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-003-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 予算を三百円超えるので、大袋はやめます。肉を少なくして四人で分けるなら、こちらの小さいパックはどうですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 千八百円の組合せをやめて小さい肉パックについて尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: That's 300 yen over budget, so I won't take the large pack. If we use less meat and share it among four, what about this smaller pack?
DLG-SC-LOC-003-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Reject the 1,800-yen combination in Japanese and ask about the smaller meat pack.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-003-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらは七百円ですので、野菜と合わせて千三百円です。量は表示をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: This one is 700 yen, so with the vegetables the total is 1,300 yen. Please check the label for the quantity.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-003-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: その組合せにします。四人の分を別々の袋にする必要はなく、一度に調理する予定です。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 千三百円の組合せを選び一緒に調理すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll take that combination. We don't need separate bags for four people; we plan to cook it all together.
DLG-SC-LOC-003-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose the 1,300-yen combination in Japanese and say you will cook everything together.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-003-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。ほかに追加する物はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. Would you like to add anything else?

DLG-SC-LOC-003-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-003-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 追加はありません。千三百円の買物で二百円残るので、レシートと残金を皆に見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 追加なしでレシートと二百円の残金を同僚に示すと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Nothing else. The shopping costs 1,300 yen, leaving 200 yen, so I'll show everyone the receipt and remaining money.
DLG-SC-LOC-003-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will add nothing and show your coworkers the receipt and remaining 200 yen.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-003-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。では、その肉と野菜をお会計へお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. Please take that meat and those vegetables to the checkout.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-003-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。今日はどのようなご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to ask about today?

DLG-SC-LOC-003-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-003-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 自分の木の棚を処分したいです。分解すれば小さな板になるので、その寸法だけ伝えればいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 所有棚の処分申込で未実施の分解後の板寸法だけ伝えてよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to dispose of my wooden shelving unit. If I take it apart it will become small boards; is it enough to give you only those dimensions?
DLG-SC-LOC-003-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether, when applying to dispose of your shelf, you may give only the dimensions of the boards after a dismantling you have not yet done.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-003-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 現時点では組み立てた棚ですか。分解は済んでいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Is it currently an assembled shelving unit? Have you finished taking it apart?

DLG-SC-LOC-003-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-003-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。幅九十センチの棚ですが、板一枚なら小さいと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 現状は幅九十センチの組立棚で分解は未実施と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. It's a shelf ninety centimetres wide, but I thought a single board would be small.
DLG-SC-LOC-003-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that it is currently an assembled shelf ninety centimetres wide and has not yet been dismantled.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-003-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 現状と分解後の予定を分けてください。受付方法を棚の状態で担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please distinguish its current condition from your plans after dismantling. The person responsible will check the application procedure based on the shelf's condition.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-003-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、まだ組み立てた棚だと伝えます。板として出せると決めずに相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 現状の棚として相談し板として出せると自己判断しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I'll explain that it is still an assembled shelf. I'd like advice rather than assuming it can be put out as boards.
DLG-SC-LOC-003-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will ask about the shelf in its current condition without deciding yourself that it can be disposed of as boards.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-003-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 写真と高さ、奥行きも分かりますか。材質の異なる部品も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you also have a photo and know its height and depth? We'll check components made of different materials too.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-003-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 高さ百二十、奥行き三十です。引き出しに金属の取手があります。写真はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 高さと奥行きと金属の取手を説明し現状写真を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: It's 120 high and 30 deep. The drawers have metal handles. Here is a photo.
DLG-SC-LOC-003-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain the height, depth and metal handles in Japanese and show a photo of its present condition.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-003-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その情報を担当へ示します。分解や出す場所は受付の案内を確認してから決めてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll show that information to the person responsible. Please decide about dismantling and where to put it out only after checking the disposal instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-003-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 棚の現状寸法と金属部品を伝えました。分解はまだせず、品目と出し方の案内を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 現状寸法と部品情報で担当へ相談し分解や搬出は案内後に決めると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've given the shelf's current dimensions and metal components. I won't dismantle it yet, and will ask about its item classification and disposal method.
DLG-SC-LOC-003-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will consult using the current dimensions and component details, and decide about dismantling and removal after the instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-003-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 資料を添えて担当へご案内します。現状の情報をありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll attach the information and direct you to the person responsible. Thank you for providing the current details.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-003-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。今日は何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you today?

DLG-SC-LOC-003-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-003-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 副収入について相談を予約しています。経費を合計したメモがありますが、これだけで話せるか見てもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 副収入相談用の合計経費メモだけでよいか確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've booked a consultation about side income. I have a note of total expenses, but I'd like you to check whether that alone is enough to discuss it.
DLG-SC-LOC-003-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether only a note of total expenses is sufficient for your side-income consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-003-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 合計だけですと内容が分かりませんね。支払日と何に使ったかは記録されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: The total alone doesn't explain the details. Do you have records of payment dates and what the money was used for?

DLG-SC-LOC-003-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-003-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 四月の合計しか書いていません。領収書は三枚ありますが、一件はなくしてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 四月の合計のみで領収書三枚と欠けた一件があると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I've only written the total for April. I have three receipts, but have lost one other receipt.
DLG-SC-LOC-003-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you have only the April total, three receipts, and one missing receipt.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-003-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: まず三枚の内容とメモを照合しましょう。資料のない一件は、何の支払いですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: First, let's compare the three receipts with the note. What was the payment for that has no supporting document?

DLG-SC-LOC-003-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-003-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 荷物の発送代です。携帯に受付メールが残っているかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 資料のない支払いは発送代で受付メールが残る可能性を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Shipping a package. There might still be a confirmation email on my phone.
DLG-SC-LOC-003-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that the payment without documentation was a shipping charge and a confirmation email may remain.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-003-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そのメールも相談用の資料にできます。ただし、経費として認められるかは担当者が内容を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: That email can also be used as material for the consultation. However, the person responsible will review the details to determine whether it is an allowable expense.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-003-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: わかりました。なくした領収書を自分で作り直すのではなく、メールを探して不足として説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 領収書を作らず既存メールを探して不足資料として説明すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I won't recreate the lost receipt myself; I'll look for the email and explain that a document is missing.
DLG-SC-LOC-003-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not make a receipt but look for the existing email and explain the missing documentation.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-003-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。合計を確定した数字として出す前に、日付、用途、資料の有無を一件ずつ整理してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Before presenting the total as a finalized figure, please organize each payment's date, purpose and whether supporting documents are available.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-003-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 三枚の領収書と発送メールを並べ、確認できない支払いには未確認と付けて相談員へ見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 支払い別に資料を並べ未確認を明記して担当へ見せると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll arrange the three receipts and shipping email, mark any payment I can't confirm as unconfirmed, and show them to the adviser.
DLG-SC-LOC-003-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will arrange documentation by payment, explicitly mark unconfirmed items, and show the person responsible.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-003-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。その状態で担当者へ引き継ぎますので、こちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll hand this over to the person responsible in that condition, so please wait here.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-09-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-003-09-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。何かお手伝いできますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-003-09-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-003-09-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人の誕生日なので、食後にデザートでお祝いしたいです。名前を書いた皿をお願いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-09-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人の誕生日に名前入りのデザート皿を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-09-001-SHARED-02.translation: It's my friend's birthday, so I'd like to celebrate with dessert after our meal. Could we have a plate with their name written on it?
DLG-SC-LOC-003-09-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for a dessert plate with your friend's name for their birthday.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-09-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-003-09-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 申し訳ありませんが、名前入りのお皿はご用意していません。通常のデザートでしたらお出しできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-09-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'm sorry, but we don't offer plates with names. We can serve a regular dessert.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-09-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-003-09-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: では普通のデザートで大丈夫です。友人にはまだ知らせていないので、席で大きな声で相談しないでいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-09-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 普通のデザートを選び席で大声の相談を避けてほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-09-001-SHARED-04.translation: A regular dessert is fine, then. My friend doesn't know yet, so could you avoid discussing it loudly at the table?
DLG-SC-LOC-003-09-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Choose a regular dessert in Japanese and ask staff not to discuss it loudly at the table.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-09-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-003-09-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 承知しました。ご注文は今ここで伺います。デザートはいくつご用意しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-09-001-SHARED-05.translation: Understood. I'll take your order here now. How many desserts would you like?

DLG-SC-LOC-003-09-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-003-09-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 小さいプリンを二つお願いします。一つは友人、一つは私の分です。ろうそくは不要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-09-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 小さいプリン二つを自分と友人用に注文しろうそく不要と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-09-001-SHARED-06.translation: Two small custard puddings, please. One for my friend and one for me. We don't need candles.
DLG-SC-LOC-003-09-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Order two small puddings for yourself and your friend in Japanese and say no candles are needed.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-09-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-003-09-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 二つですね。食事のお皿を下げた後、すぐにお出ししてよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-09-001-SHARED-07.translation: Two, then. May we bring them straight after clearing the meal dishes?

DLG-SC-LOC-003-09-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-003-09-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 先に私がカードを渡したいので、少し待ってください。カードを渡したら、こちらから声をかけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-09-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: カードを渡してから声をかけるまで提供を待ってほしいと指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-09-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd like to give them my card first, so please wait a little. Once I've given the card, I'll let you know.
DLG-SC-LOC-003-09-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for service to wait until you have handed over the card and then called the staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-09-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-003-09-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ではお客様の声掛けを待って、プリンを二つお持ちします。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-09-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then we'll wait for your signal before bringing the two puddings.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-09-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-003-09-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。名前の皿やろうそくはなしで、食後の声掛けを合図にお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-09-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 名前皿もろうそくも不要で食後の声掛けを提供の合図にすると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-003-09-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. No personalized plate or candles, and please take my call after the meal as the signal.
DLG-SC-LOC-003-09-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that no named plate or candles are needed, and your call after the meal will be the signal to serve.

DLG-SC-LOC-003-09-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-003-09-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: かしこまりました。お祝いのお時間をお楽しみください。
